parameters.content:
W10 Reschedule / cancel (4.6 item 8; W28 reschedule Flow; Schedule C/D). Entry: Execute Workflow from W07 (taps Reschedule / Other times / Cancel / Keep it, typed intents, slot picks slot_{ISO}:resched:{booking}) and W12 (broker tapped Rescheduled).
Slots ALWAYS come from the W04 slot engine (sub-workflow 'W04 Slots API', excluding the booking being moved). Booking UI: brands.booking_ui = flow -> reschedule Flow with the current booking pre-filled (automation/flows/reschedule-flow.json, completion goes W28 -> here as a pick); list -> 10-slot list in-window, reschedule_offer template (3 slots on 3 days) outside it.
Move = same appointments row + same Graph event (PATCH), reschedule_count + 1, re-checked against Outlook getSchedule AND our own bookings (buffer) inside one statement; the gist exclusion constraint is the last line of defence. Slot gone -> next 3.
Second reschedule -> flagged (escalations kind other, esc_kind=second_reschedule). Cancel -> Graph DELETE, status cancelled, W09 jobs cancelled, broker told, ONE rebooking offer.
Replacements: none of these events opens one (lead choice / Schedule D); a rebooking after a no-show writes lead_activities 'rebooked_after_no_show' so W13 stops its 48-h clock.
Broker notice: session message if the broker's 24-h window is open, else utility template broker_booking_changed (automation/templates, I-35a; pending Meta review) plus email from howzit@. Logic automation/lib/w10.mjs; tests automation/tests/W10.test.mjs.

**Schedule C1A (default pending NH-42, options a + b; `W10_C1A_MODE` = a | b | a+b | off):** a verified lead who cancels and does not rebook by the end of the rebooking offer + follow-up sequence (96 h) -> W13 `claim` uncontactable / `unreachable` / `cancel_no_rebook`; a plain "I don't want a call" / "No thanks" -> messaging stops at once (op `no_call`), then W13 `claim` disqualified / `nofit_criteria` / `no_call`; a rebook -> nothing claimed. Hourly sweep, one decision row per cancelled booking (`w10:c1a:{booking_id}`). Every send to the lead updates `leads.last_contact_at` (I-38d).

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.client_id, a.broker_id, a.brand_id, a.appointment_date, a.ends_at, a.method, a.status, a.graph_event_id, a.calendar_provider, a.reschedule_count, a.call_number, a.booked_at, a.verify_by,
       (SELECT g.payload->>'guest_email' FROM public.lead_activities g WHERE g.idempotency_key = 'w05:guest:' || a.id::text LIMIT 1) AS guest_email,
       l.first_name, l.last_name, l.phone, l.email, l.email_status, l.email_verified, l.conv_state, l.opted_out_at, l.language, l.stage,
       b.contact_person, b.fsp_number, b.practice_name, b.firm_name, b.whatsapp_number, b.email AS broker_email, b.methods_supported, b.calendar_email, b.calendar_status, b.calendar_mode, b.calendar_status_detail, b.buffer_minutes, b.slot_minutes,
       br.booking_ui, br.booking_flow_id, br.code AS brand_code, to_jsonb(br)->>'start_page' AS brand_start_page,
       (SELECT max(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'inbound') AS last_inbound_at,
       (SELECT max(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.broker_id = b.id AND c.lead_id IS NULL AND c.direction = 'inbound' AND c.sender_type = 'broker') AS broker_last_inbound_at
  FROM public.appointments a
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = a.client_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
  JOIN public.brands br ON br.id = a.brand_id
 WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND (a.id = $1::uuid OR ($1::uuid IS NULL AND a.client_id = $2::uuid))
 ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC
 LIMIT 1;

           SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments x
            WHERE x.broker_id = $2::uuid AND x.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND x.status IN ('pending_verification','booked','confirmed') AND x.id <> $1::uuid

parameters.query:
-- C1A point 2: W08 stops on declined_nurture / unbooked_closed; W07 sees declined_call. Stage kept while a booking is live.
-- R5-01: the plain "no call" is an objection -> the number hash goes on the suppression list in the SAME statement (as W08 "Save tap result").
WITH upd AS (UPDATE public.leads
   SET conv_state = COALESCE(conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) || $2::jsonb,
       stage = COALESCE($3, stage),
       updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id, phone),
sup AS (INSERT INTO public.suppression (mobile_hash, source, brand_id, lead_id, note)
        SELECT public.smc_hash_contact(upd.phone), $4, NULL, upd.id, $5 FROM upd WHERE $4 IS NOT NULL AND upd.phone IS NOT NULL
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM sup) AS suppressed;

nodes.name: C1A candidates (latest booking cancelled, not yet decided)

parameters.query:
-- W10 Schedule C1A sweep - DEFAULT PENDING NH-42 (options a + b). Latest booking per lead is cancelled (last 30 days),
-- no C1A decision row yet. Evidence = message log: who cancelled (W10 timeline actor), rebook offered, inbound after cancel.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.client_id) a.id, a.client_id, a.broker_id, a.brand_id, a.status, a.cancelled_at, a.created_at
    FROM public.appointments a
   WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY a.client_id, a.created_at DESC)
SELECT t.id AS booking_id, t.client_id AS lead_id, t.broker_id, t.brand_id, t.status, t.cancelled_at,
       l.verified_at, l.first_message_at, l.opted_out_at, l.conv_state,
       (SELECT x.actor_type FROM public.lead_activities x WHERE x.idempotency_key = 'w10:cancelled:' || t.id::text LIMIT 1) AS cancelled_by,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments a2 WHERE a2.client_id = t.client_id AND a2.id <> t.id AND a2.created_at > t.cancelled_at) AS rebooked,
       COALESCE((l.conv_state->>'rebook_offered')::boolean, false) AS rebook_offered,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('content', q.content))
                   FROM (SELECT c.content FROM public.communications c
                          WHERE c.lead_id = t.client_id AND c.direction = 'inbound' AND c.created_at > t.cancelled_at
                          ORDER BY c.created_at LIMIT 20) q), '[]'::jsonb) AS inbound_after_cancel,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.replacements r WHERE r.lead_id = t.client_id AND r.status <> 'rejected') AS already_claimed
  FROM latest t
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = t.client_id
 WHERE t.status = 'cancelled'
   AND t.cancelled_at > now() - interval '30 days'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities y WHERE y.idempotency_key = 'w10:c1a:' || t.id::text);

-- One row per cancelled booking ('w10:c1a:{booking_id}'); the claim goes to W13 only if this insert wins.
INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'W10', 'system', $4, $5::jsonb, now(), $6)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Move held slot (stays held, deadline kept)

parameters.query:
-- Verify gate (2026-10-11): a HELD slot (email not verified) moves in place and STAYS held: no Outlook event to patch, no
-- broker notice, no reminders. Same overlap + buffer re-check as a live move (held slots block time too); the deadline is
-- min(booked_at + 24 h, new start - 2 h), computed by w10.applyReschedule (moving never buys more time).
WITH chk AS (
  SELECT NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments x
            WHERE x.broker_id = $2::uuid AND x.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND x.status IN ('pending_verification','booked','confirmed') AND x.id <> $1::uuid
              AND tstzrange(x.appointment_date - make_interval(mins => $5::int), x.ends_at + make_interval(mins => $5::int), '[)')
                  && tstzrange($3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz, '[)')) AS free),
u AS (
  UPDATE public.appointments a
     SET appointment_date = $3::timestamptz, ends_at = $4::timestamptz, verify_by = $6::timestamptz, reschedule_count = a.reschedule_count + 1, updated_at = now()
    FROM chk
   WHERE a.id = $1::uuid AND chk.free AND a.status = 'pending_verification' AND a.verify_by > now()
  RETURNING a.id, a.client_id, a.brand_id, a.verify_by)
INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
SELECT u.client_id, u.brand_id, 'W10', 'lead', 'booking_held_moved', jsonb_build_object('booking_id', u.id::text, 'start', $3::text, 'verify_by', u.verify_by), now(), 'w10:held_moved:' || u.id::text || ':' || $3
  FROM u
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING lead_id;

parameters.query:
-- The cancel reason (lead_activities 'cancel_reason', one row per booking, last reason wins; no cancel_reason column exists).
-- $7 = the typed-reason wait for "Another reason" (conv_state.cancel_reason_pending: { booking_id, until }), '' = clear it.
WITH r AS (
  INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, notes, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
  SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'W10', 'lead', 'cancel_reason', jsonb_build_object('booking_id', $4::text, 'reason', $5::text), NULLIF($6, ''), now(), 'w10:cancel_reason:' || $4 WHERE $5 <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, notes = EXCLUDED.notes, occurred_at = now()
  RETURNING id),
w AS (
  UPDATE public.leads l
     SET conv_state = CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN COALESCE(l.conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('cancel_reason_pending', $7::jsonb)
                           ELSE COALESCE(l.conv_state, '{}'::jsonb) - 'cancel_reason_pending' END,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE l.id = $1::uuid AND ($7 <> '' OR l.conv_state ? 'cancel_reason_pending')
  RETURNING l.id)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r)::int AS saved, (SELECT count(*) FROM w)::int AS wait;

-- Keep my call: the typed-reason wait (cancel card "Another reason") ends, so a later message is never read as a reason.
UPDATE public.leads l SET conv_state = l.conv_state - 'cancel_reason_pending', updated_at = now()
 WHERE l.id = $1::uuid AND l.conv_state ? 'cancel_reason_pending'
RETURNING l.id;
